args.title: Handle overlapping days in dedupe.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The dedupe function in dedupe.ts does not handle cases where overlapping statements (e.g., monthly exports sharing a few days) are uploaded together. This situation results in duplicate transactions being recorded. Modify the dedupe function to correctly identify duplicates even when statements overlap and are uploaded consecutively.

file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The dedupe functionality in dedupe.ts does not currently handle cases of overlapping days when two statements are uploaded consecutively. This leads to duplicate transactions being recorded. The dedupe function needs to be updated to address this issue.
